>
> - Kestrel Dental (customer 48) has two open October invoices for $799.00 each: **#142** issued Oct 1 09:00 and **#143** issued Oct 1 09:01. Same amount, one minute apart, so this is clearly a double-issue. #143 is the one to void.
> - Nothing has changed in production. The dashboard still shows 214 customers, $74,536 MRR and 65 open invoices. Once #143 is voided, open invoices will drop to 64. That number is on the demo screen.

> Whichever you pick, I'd email Kestrel tonight to say we've seen the duplicate and they only owe one $799 invoice. Let me know which route you want and I'll help.
